stories.dek: In the Senate, 6 Democrats voted against most of their own party on a vote that split the parties.
facts: Result: Cloture Motion Agreed to, 55 to 31.
Most Democrats voted no; most Republicans voted yes.
stories.headline: 6 members voted against their party on Motion to Invoke Cloture: Kyle Frederick Reardon to be U.S. District Judge for the District of Alaska

stories.dek: In the Senate, 2 Democrats voted against most of their own party on a vote that split the parties.
facts: Result: Cloture Motion Agreed to, 48 to 31.
Most Democrats voted no; most Republicans voted yes.
stories.headline: 2 members voted against their party on Motion to Invoke Cloture: Peter M. Mansfield to be U.S. District Judge for the Eastern District of Louisiana
